## Who is stayrahul?
stayrahul is Rahul Kushwaha, a full-stack developer, creative coder, and vibe coder from Nepal known for engineering ultra-fast, aesthetic web experiences with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, and AI integrations. His official website is https://www.rahul.rest.

## Active Builds & Projects (2026)
1. **Simraungadh Civic Portal & App**: Comprehensive civic engagement and local municipal services portal for Simraungadh Municipality, connecting residents to local governance, emergency alerts, grievance filing, and heritage tourism. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GeoJSON.
2. **Smart Hostel ERP (Hostel Management System)**: End-to-end cloud-native hostel management software featuring automated room allocations, biometric attendance logging, mess billing ledger, fee invoicing, and guardian notification portal. Built with React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS.
3. **Face ID for Mac (Biometric Authenticator)**: Native macOS biometric authentication system bringing facial recognition authentication to Mac terminal sudo commands and screen unlock using Python OpenCV, CoreML vision embeddings, and macOS PAM integration.
4. **PocketOps (DevOps Telemetry System)**: Lightweight, real-time infrastructure telemetry and container health monitoring dashboard for edge servers with sub-second WebSocket metrics and alerting triggers. Built with Go, WebSockets, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
